stations.title: Dilys
stations.note: A man paid twice last month.

stations.title: Booking form
stations.text: Pressing Book a place reloads the page.

stations.title: Studio API
stations.text: Books the place, or says why not.

captions: Dilys wants people to book a place from the screen, once per press.
Pressing the button only reloads the page, and nothing reaches the API.
You send the booking as JSON, turn the button off meanwhile, and show refusals.
Now one press books one place, and a full class says why it did not work.
The booking reaches the API exactly once, and the screen says how it went.
